verdict.rationale: The Sonar API reference shows responses carry a `citations` array of strings and a `search_results` array, and the Search API returns ranked results as structured data. This is direct support for source citation, but the evidence never shows which per-result fields exist. Missing for 10: documented title and published-date fields on results, explicit confirmation that citations are canonical URLs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of citation accuracy.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on results carrying canonical URLs, titles, and published dates so my app can cite sources accurately

citations.quote: Perplexity's Search API returns real-time, ranked web results as structured data
Get accurate, up-to-date answers grounded in real-time web search, with inline citations in a single call
